name: centraid-monorepo
description: Centraid — a personal, local-first superapp for desktop, installable web, and mobile clients.

scripts.check:fast: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck:affected
scripts.check:full: bun run check:pr && bun run test:affected:full && bun run coverage && bun run test:suite-wall-clock && bun run test:mutation:pr && bun run test:perf:pr && bun run --cwd apps/desktop test:e2e && bun run --cwd apps/web e2e
scripts.check:pr: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check:push && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:types && bun run lint:workflow-pins && bun run check:diff-coverage
scripts.check:push: node scripts/ci/run-gates.ts --stamp test:affected test:qualities design:gallery knip typecheck:affected scripts:test test:ratchet:unit check:reachability format:check turbo:lint lint lint:product lint:hermes-surface test:claims lint:evidence-mapping test:report:smoke test:governance-shell
scripts.check:push:static: node scripts/ci/run-gates.ts --stamp format:check lint turbo:lint typecheck:affected
scripts.coverage: node scripts/test-report/prepare.ts --lane vitest && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=artifacts/test-results/vitest.json
scripts.coverage:shard: node scripts/test-report/prepare.ts --lane vitest && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.shard.config.ts --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=blob --shard="$CENTRAID_COVERAGE_SHARD"
scripts.docs:bundle: DOCS_SITE_BASE_PATH=/docs node scripts/docs-site/build.ts && bun install --cwd centraid-city --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd centraid-city build:site && node scripts/docs-site/assemble.ts
scripts.lint:design-consumers: bun run lint:design-tokens && bun run lint:mobile-design
scripts.perf:gateway: node scripts/ci/turbo.ts run build --filter=@centraid/server && bun run --cwd packages/server perf:low-end
scripts.scripts:test: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config scripts/release/vitest.config.ts && bun run release:surfaces:test && node --test scripts/lib/sanitize-connector-svg.test.ts scripts/design-gallery-fidelity.test.ts scripts/lint-design-tokens.test.ts scripts/lint-mobile-design.test.ts scripts/lint-logical-insets.test.ts scripts/lint-hairline.test.ts scripts/lint-workflow-pins.test.ts scripts/ci/file-tracking-issue.test.ts scripts/ci/rolling-issue-fallback-body.test.ts scripts/ci/burn-in.test.ts scripts/ci/mutation-cap.test.ts scripts/ci/pr-gate-wall-clock.test.ts scripts/ci/turbo-floor.test.ts scripts/ci/write-candidate.test.ts scripts/ci/resolve-candidate.test.ts scripts/ci/run-slug.test.ts scripts/ci/hygiene-gates.test.ts scripts/ci/collection-tripwire.test.ts scripts/ci/assert-shard-blobs.test.ts scripts/ci/advisory-expiry.test.ts scripts/ci/lane-health.test.ts scripts/ci/osv-lockfile-scan.test.ts scripts/lint-e2e-flows.test.ts scripts/lint-e2e-wiring.test.ts scripts/lint-mobile-testids.test.ts scripts/lint-vault-sql.test.ts scripts/check-mobile-suite-budgets.test.ts scripts/lint-tsconfigs.test.ts scripts/lint-turbo-cache.test.ts scripts/lint-path-filters.test.ts scripts/ci/turbo-cache-report.test.ts scripts/lint-css-classes.test.ts scripts/lint-protocol-routes.test.ts scripts/lint-law-registry.test.ts scripts/lint-engine-conformance.test.ts scripts/lint-engine-conformance-registry.test.ts scripts/check-mobile-native-state.test.ts scripts/check-share-reachability.test.ts scripts/lint-hermes-array-surface.test.ts scripts/security/dast-scan.test.ts scripts/security/rust-supply-chain.test.ts scripts/security/unsafe-edge-audit.test.ts scripts/security/supply-chain-core.test.ts scripts/security/dependency-behaviour.test.ts tests/agent-e2e-compat/lib/skew.test.ts tests/agent-e2e-compat/lib/upgrade.test.ts scripts/check-ledgers.test.ts scripts/check-comment-density-ratchet.test.ts scripts/lint-app-conformance.test.ts scripts/lint-product.test.ts scripts/validate-ui-receipt.test.ts scripts/ci/gate-classes.test.ts scripts/ci/gate-stamp.test.ts scripts/ci/run-gates.test.ts scripts/ci/turbo.test.ts scripts/lint-test-reachability.test.ts scripts/lint-no-nul-bytes.test.ts scripts/design-gallery-browser.test.ts scripts/ci/work-counter-gate.test.ts scripts/lint-journey-ledger.test.ts scripts/ci/paired-journeys.test.ts scripts/ci/bisect-journeys.test.ts scripts/perf/app-waterfall.test.ts && bun run governance:law:test
scripts.test: node scripts/ci/turbo.ts run test && node scripts/test-report/report-floors.ts
scripts.test:perf: node scripts/test-report/prepare.ts --lane perf && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.perf.config.ts
scripts.test:quality:nightly: bun run test:perf && bun run test:scale && bun run test:report
scripts.test:scale: node scripts/test-report/prepare.ts --lane scale && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.scale.config.ts
scripts.test:suite: node scripts/test-report/prepare.ts --lane vitest && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=artifacts/test-results/vitest.json
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/ci/turbo.ts run typecheck && tsc -p tests && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.agent-e2e.json && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.pricing.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.design.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.tool-configs.json
scripts.typecheck:affected: node scripts/ci/turbo.ts run typecheck --filter='[origin/main]' && tsc -p tests && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.agent-e2e.json && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.pricing.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.design.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.tool-configs.json
